exposure: educational intervention based on the Theory of Planned Behavior (TPB)
cohort: The study included 100 primiparous women covered by health centers in Firouzabad County, Fars Province, Iran.
finding: The educational intervention based on the Theory of Planned Behavior (TPB) was effective in establishing behavioral intention for selecting natural delivery type among primiparous women.
mod_finding: The TPB-based educational intervention successfully promoted behavioral intention in primiparous women, enabling them to choose the optimal delivery method according to their circumstances.
